tasks.prompt: Create slug.js (CommonJS) exporting a function slugify(str) via module.exports = { slugify }. It lowercases the text, trims it, and replaces runs of spaces with a single hyphen. Also create slug.test.js with three simple tests using node:assert.

Create fib.js (CommonJS) exporting a function fib(n) via module.exports = { fib } that returns the nth Fibonacci number (fib(0) = 0, fib(1) = 1). Also create fib.test.js with three simple tests using node:assert.
